reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We're thrilled to share some significant improvements to the water mechanics in Provincia! With the latest updates, water depth is now handled more efficiently, allowing for smoother gameplay when shaping the terrain. The new system ensures that water accurately reflects changes in the landscape without causing performance issues. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Provincia's Water Mechanics Get a Major Upgrade!
steam.body: We're excited to announce that the water mechanics in Provincia have been significantly improved! The new system allows for real-time adjustments to water depth without freezing the frame, making your city-building experience smoother and more enjoyable. For a detailed look at these enhancements, check out our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
